pipeline.inspectNotes: Bead reconcile-journals-sweep BLOCKED: src/lib/cloister/advancing-selfheal.ts:45-48 isReconciliableStatus() requires BOTH status.reviewStatus AND status.testStatus to be in JOURNAL_RECONCILE_STATES (line 15: pending/reviewing/passed/failed/blocked/testing/dispatch_failed). That set omits the legitimate testStatus value "skipped" (a real, commonly-set value per src/lib/review-status.ts:45, treated on par with passed for merge-gating at lines 144/173/873/901/937). Any issue with reviewStatus: reviewing|pending (clearly in-flight) and testStatus: skipped (tests not required/applicable) is silently excluded from both the DB-row loop (line 74) and the tmux-alive session loop (line 89) — reconcileInFlightJournals never calls getReviewStatusSync for it, so a journaled advancing verdict on such an issue is never reconciled. This violates FR-1 (must call getReviewStatusSync for every in-flight issue) and is not caught by the shipped tests, which only ever construct status() with testStatus: pending (default) and never exercise skipped. Fix: change isReconciliableStatus to gate on reviewStatus alone (or on either field independently, with skipped treated as a valid non-excluding testStatus), then add a test case with testStatus: skipped + reviewStatus: reviewing to prove the fix. Everything else in the commit checks out: getReviewStatusSync already owns journal->DB reconcile (review-status.ts:757, PAN-1988), the sweep call at deacon.ts:2722 genuinely precedes checkTerminalAdvancingSessions at deacon.ts:2846 (confirmed live, not just the ordering test), and startDeacon triggers runScheduledPatrol(startup) before the interval loop so FR-1s on-boot language is satisfied via the patrol path. markAdvancingSessionStopped is correctly unwired per the beads own scope (wire sweep into the patrol — singular), so that is not a blocker.
